title: group_oscore: _previous retains every historical key forever (forward-secrecy gap)
description: python/src/lichen/crypto/group_oscore.py:122,195,164-171: rekey() appends to _previous and nothing purges it; key_valid_at only gates use past the grace window while the material stays in memory (and key_for_epoch does a growing linear scan). A single memory compromise of the controller retroactively exposes all past group traffic keys, contradicting the module's forward-secrecy framing and the docstring's 'previous epoch+key' (singular) design. Fix: after rekey, drop entries whose created_s + GRACE_PERIOD_S < now and zeroize where practical.
